questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that when sides AB and DC are produced, they meet at E, and sides AD and BC meet at F, when produced. If ∠ADE = 80° and ∠AED = 50°, then what is the measure of ∠AFB?
questions.solution: Given: ∠ADE = 80° ∠AED = 50° Concept used: In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles are 180° Sum of linear pair of angles of is always 180° Sum of all 3 interior angles of triangle is 180° Calculation: ∠ADE + ∠ABC = 180° ⇒ 80° + ∠ABC = 180° ⇒ ∠ABC = (180° – 80°) ⇒ ∠ABC = 100° ∠ABC + ∠CBE = 180° [straight line] ⇒ 100° + ∠CBE = 180° ⇒ ∠CBE = (180° – 100°) ⇒ ∠CBE = 80° In ΔAED ⇒ ∠AED + ∠CBE + ∠ECB = 180° ⇒ 50° + 80° + ∠ECB = 180° ⇒ 130° + ∠ECB = 180° ⇒ ∠ECB = (180° – 130°) ⇒ ∠ECB = 50° Now, ⇒ ∠ECB = ∠DCF = 50° (Vertically opposite angles) and ∠FDC = 180° - ∠ADC (Linear pair) ∠FDC = 180° - 80° = 100° ∠FDC + ∠DCF + ∠AFB = 180° ⇒ 100° + 50° + ∠AFB = 180° ⇒ 150° + ∠AFB = 180° ⇒ ∠AFB = (180° – 150°) ⇒ ∠AFB = 30° ∴ The required value of ∠AFB is 30° Alternate Method From the above diagram, ⇒ ∠ADC + ∠CDF = 180° [ Linear pair of angles] ⇒ 80° + ∠CDF = 180° ⇒ ∠CDF = 100° Now, In ΔAED ⇒ ∠AED + ∠ADE + ∠EAD = 180° ⇒ 50° + 80° + ∠EAD = 180° ⇒ ∠EAD = 180° - 130° = 50° Now, ∠EAD = ∠DCF = 50° In ΔDCF ⇒ ∠CDF + ∠DFC + ∠DCF = 180° ⇒ 100° + ∠DFC + 50° = 180° ⇒ ∠DFC = 180° - 150° = 30° ⇒ ∠DFC = ∠AFB = 30° ∴ The required value of ∠AFB is 30°

questions.question: A customer wanted to purchase an item marked for Rs. 10000. Shopkeeper offered two types of discounts, 25% flat discount or successive discounts of 14% and 12%. Which is the better offer for the customers and by how much?
questions.solution: Given: An item purchased by customer = Rs. 10000 First types of discounts = 25% Second types of discount = successive discounts of 14% and 12%. Formula used: Single discount on two successive discount = (a + b – ab/100) Calculation: According to the question Single discount on two successive discount = (a + b – ab/100) ⇒ (14 + 12 – 14 × 12/100) ⇒ (26 – 1.68) ⇒ 24.32% The best discount = First types of discount – Second types of discount ⇒ (25 – 24.32)% ⇒ 0.68% Now, The better offer for the customers = Rs. (10000 × 0.68/100) ⇒ Rs. 68 ∴ First offer by Rs. 68

questions.question: If 2x + 3y + 1 = 0, then what is the value of (8x3 + 8 + 27y3 - 18xy)?
questions.solution: Given: 2x + 3y = -1 Formula used: (a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab(a + b) Calculation: According to the question 2x + 3y + 1 = 0 ⇒ 2x + 3y = -1 Now, (2x + 3y)3 = (2x)3 + (3y)3 + 3 × 2x × 3y (-1) = -1 ⇒ 8x3 + 27y3 – 18xy = -1 Now, The value of (8x3 + 8 + 27y3 – 18xy) = (8 – 1) ⇒ 7 ∴ The required value is 7

questions.question: In a triangle ABC, length of the side AC is 4 cm more than 2 times the length of the side AB. Length of the side BC is 4 cm less than the three times the length of the side AB. If the perimeter of ΔABC is 60 cm, then its area (in cm2) is:
questions.solution: Given: Length of the side AC is 4 cm more than 2 times the length of the side AB Length of the side BC is 4 cm less than the three times the length of the side AB. The perimeter of ΔABC = 60 cm Formula used: Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height Calculation: Let the side of AB be x cm Then, Length of the side AC is 4 cm more than 2 times the length of the side AB = (2x + 4) cm Length of the side BC is 4 cm less than the three times the length of the side AB. = (3x – 4) cm Perimeter of ΔABC = 60 cm ⇒ (x + 2x + 4 + 3x – 4) = 60 ⇒ 6x = 60 ⇒ x = 10 cm Now, Side of AB = x = 10 cm Side of AC = (2x + 4) = (2 × 10 + 4) = 24 cm Side of BC = (3x – 4) = (3 × 10 – 4) = 26 cm We know that 10, 24, and 26 is a triplet, ⇒ We can say that the given triangle is a Right angle triangle. Now, ⇒ Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height Area of triangle = (1/2 × 10 × 24) ⇒ (5 × 24) ⇒ 120 cm2 ∴ The required area is 120 cm2

questions.question: The average of 23 numbers is 51. The average of first 12 numbers is 49 and the average of last 12 numbers is 54. If the twelfth number is removed, then the average of the remaining numbers (correct to two decimal places) is:
questions.solution: Given: The average of 23 numbers = 51 The average of first 12 numbers = 49 The average of last 12 numbers = 54 Formula used: Average = sum of observations/Number of observations Calculation: The sum of 23 numbers = (23 × 51) = 1173 The sum of first 12 numbers = (12 × 49) = 588 The sum of last 12 numbers = (12 × 54) = 648 Now, The twelfth number = [(588 + 648) – 1173] ⇒ (1236 – 1173) ⇒ 63 The 12th number = 63 Now, If the twelfth number is removed, The sum of remaining numbers = (1173 – 63) = 1110 The average of remaining number = (1110/22) ⇒ 50.45 ∴ The required average number is 50.45

questions.solution: Given: Time taken to complete a work by A = \(11\frac{1}{2}\) days = 23/2 days B is 25% more efficient than A = (25/100) = 1/4 Efficiency of A = 4 days Efficiency of B = (4 + 1) = 5 days C is 50% efficient than B = (50/100) = 1/2 Efficiency of C = (5/2) = 2.5 days Formula used: Work = Efficiency × Time Calculation: Total work = (23/2 × 4) = 46 days Total time taken by A, B and C together = [46/(4 + 5 + 2.5)] days ⇒ (46/11.5) days ⇒ 4 days ∴ The required time is 4 days Shortcut TrickEfficiency of them So, total work = 8 × 23/2 = 92 units Total time taken by A, B and C together = [92/(8 + 10 + 5)] = 4 days

questions.solution: Given: AD ⊥ BC ∠B = 68° ∠C = 52° Calculation: Join O to B where point O is the circum centre of the triangle. ⇒ ∠BOA = 2∠BCA ⇒ 2 × 52° ⇒ 104° In ΔBOA ⇒ OB = OA [radius of the circle] ⇒ ∠OBA = ∠OAB ⇒ ∠AOB + ∠OAB + ∠OBA = 180° ⇒ 2∠OAB = (180° – 104°) ⇒ 2∠OAB = 76° ⇒ ∠OAB = (76/2) ⇒ ∠OAB = 38° In ΔABD ⇒ ∠ABD + ∠BDA + ∠DAB = 180° ⇒ ∠DAB = (180° – 90° – 68°) ⇒ ∠DAB = 22° Now, ∠DAP = ∠BAO – ∠BAD ⇒ ∠DAP = (38° – 22°) ⇒ ∠DAP = 16° So, the required value is 16°

questions.question: The sum of 3-digit numbers abc, cab and bca is not divisible by:
questions.solution: Given: The sum of three digit numbers = abc, cab and bca Calculation: We have, ⇒ abc + cab + bca = (100a + 10b + c) + (100c + 10a + b) + (100b + 10c + a) ⇒ (100a + 10a + a) + (100b + 10b + b) + (100c + 10c + c) ⇒ (111a + 111b + 111c) ⇒ 111(a + b + c) ⇒ 3 × 37(a + b + c) ∴ The number abc, cab and bca are not divisible by 31.

questions.question: If a4 + b4 + a2b2 = 273 and a2 + b2 - ab = 21, then one of the value of \(\left(\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}\right)\) is:
questions.solution: Given: a4 + b4 + a2b2 = 273 and a2 + b2 - ab = 21 Formula used: (a2 + b2 + ab) (a2 + b2 – ab) = a4 + b4 + a2b2 Calculation: a4 + b4 + a2b2 = 273 ⇒ (a2 + b2 + ab) (a2 + b2 – ab) = 273 ⇒ (a2 + b2 + ab) (21) = 273 ⇒ (a2 + b2 + ab) = (273/21) ⇒ (a2 + b2 + ab) = 13 ....(1) a2 + b2 – ab = 21 .....(2) Adding equation (1) and (2), we get ⇒ (a2 + b2 + ab) = 13 + a2 + b2 – ab = 21 ⇒ 2(a2 + b2) = (21 + 13) ⇒ 2(a2 + b2) = 34 ⇒ a2 + b2 = 17 Putting the value of 17 in equation (2) ⇒ 17 – ab = 21 ⇒ -ab = 4 ⇒ ab = -4 Now, (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab ⇒ (a + b)2 = 17 + 2 × (-4) ⇒ (a + b)2 = 17 – 8 ⇒ (a + b)2 = 9 ⇒ (a + b) = 3 Then, The value of \(\left(\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}\right)\) ⇒ [(b + a)/ab] = [3/(-4)] ⇒ -3/4 ∴ The required value is -3/4

questions.question: A train covers 450 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 5 km/h more, it would have taken 1 hour less to cover the same distance. How much time will it take to cover 315 km at its usual speed?
questions.solution: Alternate MethodLet the actual speed be x km/h and the actual time taken be t hr. Distance = (X × Y)/(X - Y) × [Time Difference] ⇒ 450 = {x × (x + 5)}/(x + 5 - x) × [t + 1 - t] ⇒ 450 = [x(x + 5)]/5 ⇒ 2250 = x × (x + 5) ⇒ 2250 = 45 × (45 + 5) On comparing x = 45 km/h Actual time taken = 315/45 = 7 hr Traditional method: Given: If the speed had been 5 km/h more, the train covered a distance = 450 km If speed had been 1 hour less, the train covered a same distance Formula used: Speed = Distance/Time Calculation: Let the speed of train be x km According to the question ⇒ 450/x – 450/x + 5 = 1 ⇒ 450(x + 5) – 450x = x2 + 5x ⇒ 450x + 2250 – 450x = x2 + 5x ⇒ x2 + 5x – 2250 = 0 ⇒ x2 + 50x – 45x - 2250 = 0 ⇒ x(x + 50) – 45(x + 50) = 0 ⇒ (x – 45)(x + 50) = 0 ⇒ x = – 50, 45 ⇒ x = 45 km/h Now, Time taken to cover the distance of 315 km = (315/45) ⇒ 7 h ∴ The required time is 7 h

questions.question: If \(x+\frac{1}{x}=7\), then \(x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}\)is equal to:
questions.solution: Given: \(x+\frac{1}{x}=7\) Formula used: (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab Calculation: According to the question \(x+\frac{1}{x}=7\) squaring both sides, we get ⇒ (x)2 + (1/x)2 + 2 × x × 1/x = (7)2 ⇒ x2 + 1/x2 + 2 = 49 ⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = (49 – 2) ⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 47 ∴ The required value is 47
